name: Alexston Farmstead
summary: At Alexston Farmstead, wild Harvest Watchers prowl the ruined fields. Baros Alexston grew up here before becoming Stormwind's city architect.

sections.title: A Fallen Homestead
sections.body: Alexston Farmstead lies amid Westfall's dry plains, abandoned like the neighboring estates. Its caretakers fled when banditry spread across the countryside. Now the fields have grown wild, and the Harvest Watchers left to tend the crops attack anyone who comes near the barren farmhouse.

sections.title: Humble Roots
sections.body: Baros Alexston spent his youth working these fields before leaving to pursue masonry and construction. He became one of Stormwind's most prominent citizens, helping design parts of the rebuilt capital. Something from his early life remains among the ruins.

faq.answer: The Alexston family gives the farmstead its name. Baros Alexston, Stormwind's city architect, worked this land as a boy before moving to the capital to pursue architecture.
Like much of Westfall, the farmstead was abandoned after widespread unrest and Defias Brotherhood banditry. With the kingdom unable to protect them, the farmers fled and left the homestead to decay.

faq.q: Why are mechanical scarecrows attacking people here?
faq.answer: The Harvest Watchers were built to work the soil and guard crops from scavengers. After the farmers fled, the machines went without maintenance, and their clockwork failed. Now they attack living creatures.

faq.q: Is there anything hidden inside the farmhouse?
faq.answer: Baros Alexston left his personal compass in the farmhouse from his youth. Travelers working in Stormwind City are sometimes asked to retrieve it from the abandoned homestead.

angles.text: For the Alliance, the farm recalls the humble, hardworking beginnings of Stormwind's finest minds and the struggle to protect its borders.
